beforeAfter.before: Moving that same task into a later calendar opening doesn't change what it includes, since fitting work into a time slot is very different from deciding how much belongs inside the commitment itself. editingPrinciples.principle: Move a reviewed visible object or gesture before its abstract explanation. Use its concrete consequence once; do not paraphrase the same distinction in a second formal sentence.

editingPrinciples.principle: Put if, can or may on the claim it limits. A conditional scene in one sentence does not license a new definite claim about the reader later. Repeat a short condition where paragraph distance could lose its scope.

editingPrinciples.principle: Do not add speed, ease, frequency or necessity while shortening. Removing quickly or easily is insufficient if can or may also disappears.
